Recipe for Spicy Green Chili Pickle Shared

Two Hindi news outlets have shared recipes for making a spicy green chili pickle, referred to as 'tipore' or 'achar'. The recipes emphasize quick preparation, with one stating it can be made in 5 minutes without needing to be sun-dried for days. The pickle is suggested as a flavorful accompaniment to meals like dal-rice and rotis or parathas, especially when other vegetables are unavailable.
